subject: MSA + Order Form: multi-tier notice ladder, off-ramp options, and consolidated redline
messages:
From: Mike O'Rourke <mike.orourke@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.klein@sunrisehealth.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on notice windows + TFC language in MSA redline

Rafael — thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal reviewed the latest MSA and have two sticking points before we can route to execs:

1) Auto-renew mechanics: your current Order Form implies annual auto-renew with a 60-day notice to opt out. We need clarity on what constitutes "notice" (email to a specific address? signed amendment?).

2) Termination for convenience (TFC): Sunrise is requesting a 30-day TFC for pilots and a 60-day TFC for paid commitments; legal flagged this as inconsistent with Redwood's internal offboarding SLA.

Attached is our annotated redline — the highlights are PRAGMATICALLY: define notice channel, tiered notice for pilots vs committed, and a one-time transition assistance fee if terminated inside the first 6 months.

Can you confirm internal willingness to accept a tiered notice ladder (30/60) or propose an alternative? Also, what's Redwood's minimum data-export/support window for offboarding?

Mike

Attachments: Sunrise_MSA_redline_20260927.pdf (pdf, 42KB)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Mike O'Rourke <mike.orourke@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.klein@sunrisehealth.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@sunrisehealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on notice windows + TFC language in MSA redline

Mike — thanks for the clear notes and the redline. Looping Naomi (legal) and Ben (account lead) so we can give a consolidated response. High level from sales: we understand the ask to make pilots low-friction — happy to accept a 30-day pilot TFC, but for committed (paid) seats we need 60 days minimum to coordinate data export and scheduled deprovisioning.

Two operational constraints to flag now:
- Offboarding runbook requires a 45-day window for full KV-cache drain + export for models with >1B tokens stored in customer KV.
- For orders that include Dedicated capacity, provisioning lead times and committed pool rebalancing make a 60-day runway necessary or else we need to apply a pro-rated early-exit charge.

Naomi — can you draft suggested language that preserves the 30/60 split but adds a short carve for Dedicated and a 45-day export step? Ben — thoughts on commercial trade (credit, short support fee)?

Rafael
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Mike O'Rourke <mike.orourke@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.klein@sunrisehealth.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@sunrisehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Questions on notice windows + TFC language in MSA redline

Mike / team — copied below is proposed consolidated clause set that addresses your points while keeping Redwood's operational needs. (I'm pasting the working language here and have attached a PDF redline that inserts these edits directly into your file.)

Proposed (high level):
- Notice: written notice to the parties' respective commercial contacts (email to sales@redwood.com and to the Account Manager) or by DocuSign-signed amendment. Electronic notice to the designated procurement email constitutes delivery.
- Tiered TFC: Pilot engagements: 30 days' notice. Paid commitments: 60 days' notice. Dedicated capacity: 90 days' notice OR pro-rated early-exit fee equal to remaining committed monthly fees.
- Offboarding & Export: Redwood will provide a minimum 45-day data export window after receipt of notice for model artifacts, KV exports, and billing reconciliation. If Customer requires an accelerated export (<45 days), Redwood will quote a dedicated-offboarding fee.
- Auto-Renew: Order Forms auto-renew for one additional term unless Customer provides written notice within the applicable notice window for termination prior to the renewal effective date. We clarifiy that "written notice" follows the Notice channel above.

I do recommend adding a short commercial concession to close this: for signed 12-month commitments, Redwood will waive the early-exit fee for the first 30 days of termination notice (i.e., promote a 30-day grace within the 60-day window) — that reduces friction while protecting the dedicated pool economics. Ben, Rafael: confirm whether sales OKs that concession.

Attachment: Sunrise_MSA_redline_20260927_Redwood_comments.pdf (pdf, 28KB)

Naomi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike O'Rourke <mike.orourke@sunrisehealth.com>, Sara Klein <sara.klein@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Questions on notice windows + TFC language in MSA redline

All — sales perspective: Naomi's language is sensible and should close. A couple of commercial asks from our side to make Sunrise comfortable and keep ARR intact:

- Offer: For annual paid commitments >= $250k, apply a one-time offboarding credit equal to 5% of the remaining term (capped at 3 months' fees) instead of a punitive early-exit charge. This is easier to explain to Procurement than a complicated pro-rate formula.
- Operational SLA: commit to a single named technical POC for the 45-day export window and provide an export checklist with estimated timeline at the time notice is delivered.

If Sunrise accepts those two items, I think we can move quickly. Rafael — if you agree, I'll prepare a short addendum to the Order Form that shows the credit and named POC line item so Procurement can sign off.

Ben
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike O'Rourke <mike.orourke@sunrisehealth.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on notice windows + TFC language in MSA redline

Thanks — that framework is much clearer. Two quick clarifications from our legal/procurement side:

1) The 90-day carve for Dedicated is okay, but can we have a fallback that allows a Customer to pay an "accelerated deprovisioning fee" (we're fine with a quote) rather than be forced into 90 days. Essentially, we want a paid option to shorten the timeline.

2) The 30-day grace inside the 60-day window for 12-month commitments is acceptable if that concession is documented in the Order Form (we need explicit language).

If you can provide a consolidated redline and a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form addendum (credit + named POC + accelerated deprovisioning fee option), Procurement will circulate for final sign-off today.

Sara
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@sunrisehealth.com>, Mike O'Rourke <mike.orourke@sunrisehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: consolidated redline + DocuSign for Order Form addendum

Sara / Mike — attached is the consolidated redline that reflects: (a) notice channel language (email to sales@redwood.com / named AM), (b) tiered TFC (30/60/90 with paid acceleration option), (c) 45-day export baseline and accelerated-offboarding fee path, and (d) the commercial concession for 12-month deals (30-day grace) plus the 5% offboarding credit for deals >= $250k.

I've also opened a DocuSign envelope for the addendum so Procurement can sign the Order Form changes once internal review completes: https://www.docusign.com/--/envelope/ABCDEF123456

If we get confirmation by end of day, legal can countersign on our side tomorrow AM and we can schedule the kickoff. Thanks for moving fast here — appreciate the pragmatic approach.

Rafael

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_clean_20260929.docx (docx, 14KB); Sunrise_MSA_redline_20260927_Redwood_final.pdf (pdf, 31KB)
